newsitem.title: USA: Dow index ends strong after a week of record highs.
newsitem.headline: Dow index ends strong after a week of record highs.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average ended on a strong note Friday, setting its fourth record in a week in which it closed above 6,000 points for the first time.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow closed up 35.03 points at a new high of 6,094.23, surpassing Thursday's record of 6,059.20. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 13-10 on heavy volume of 471 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
